name: Enhanced Caravan
body:
Your caravan is flat-out better than most.

Prerequisite: Caravan level 2.

Benefit: When you gain this feat, increase two of your caravan’s primary statistics (Offense, Defense, Mobility, or Morale) by +1, to a maximum score of 10 per primary statistic.

Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Its effects stack.
